crop: Pineapple (Ananas comosus), Smooth Cayenne and similar, open field, Cameroon

cycle.text: Harvest between the 12th and 18th month after planting suckers (S1). Floral induction (TIF) between six months (large suckers) and one year (small suckers) after planting; fruit ripe about 5 months after TIF (S1). Planting to TIF 7 to 13 months, TIF to harvest about 160 days (145 to 174), planting to harvest 12 to 18 months (S2).

density.text: 55,000 to 77,000 plants/ha are common in Cameroon (S1). Twin rows 90 x 40 x 28 cm give 55,000 plants/ha; beginners are advised about 45,000 (S2).

planting_material.text: Suckers of 200 to 500 g (S1), 300 to 600 g, cayeux and hapas preferred (S2). Sucker price 7 FCFA in a Benin budget (S3).

fertilizer.text: Per plant: urea 7.36 g + NPK 3.66 g three months after planting, urea 3.67 g + NPK 7.33 g three months later, NPK 7.33 g + potassium sulphate 10.16 g three months later (S3). Needs per plant 8 to 14 g N, 10 to 20 g K2O, 0 to 5 g P2O5 (S1).

induction.text: Ethrel 6 to 10 ml per 10 L of water, 10 L of mix for 200 plants (S1); repeat at 3 day intervals (S2). Calcium carbide 44 kg/ha in Benin (S3).

yields.text: Average 31 t/ha in Cameroon (S1). 50 t/ha in a Togo example (S2). 75.6 t/ha, 1.15 kg mean fruit, on an intensive Benin budget (S3). Fruit 0.8 to 2 kg (S4).

labour.text: 925 person days/ha over 3.5 years including ratoon crops and sucker sales in Togo (S2); labour 1,938,335 FCFA/ha on the Benin fresh fruit budget (S3).

prices.text: Wholesale 400,000 to 600,000 FCFA per tonne; retail 100 to 400 FCFA per fruit; average production cost 6,000,000 FCFA/ha (S1, 2024).
